hints.title: Graph State Representation
hints.text: Treat each 4-digit combination as a vertex in an unweighted graph, with edges connecting combinations that differ by a single wheel turn.

hints.title: Deadend Avoidance
hints.text: Store deadends in a fast lookup set. If "0000" or the target is in the deadends set, return negative one immediately.

hints.title: Breadth-First Exploration
hints.text: Run a breadth-first search starting from "0000" level by level. For each node, generate the eight adjacent states by turning each of the four wheels up or down modulo 10.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: BFS level order exploration on unweighted state transition graph.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: DFS without cycle detection loops infinitely around wheel rotations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Visited hash set caps storage at 10,000 states, resolving shortest path in constant time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use bidirectional BFS or standard BFS with modular arithmetic for wheel turns.
